title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
abstract: arXiv:2611.13509v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot front

translated_title: 移动AI工厂：为您的移动设备构建专用语言模型
translated_abstract: 在移动设备上运行的小型语言模型（SLM）可以保护用户数据隐私，并在无网络连接的情况下工作。但只有在针对目标任务进行微调并针对目标设备进行尺寸适配时，它们才能表现良好，而这一过程目前需要专家反复调优。我们提出了Mobile AI Factory，这是一个智能体系统，可以为给定任务和手机构建经过微调和量化的小型语言模型。给定任务规范和目标手机后，一个编排器LLM会选择是调整超参数、挖掘真实数据还是生成合成样本，同时固定规则会回滚损害准确性的更改。该工厂从小到大依次搜索模型，涵盖不同的基础模型和量化方案，并在搜索过程中自适应调整准确性目标，同时使用目标手机在不同推理引擎和后端上的真实测量数据。我们在十个任务和四部Android手机上评估了Mobile AI Factory。在未见过的测试集上，其端侧模型优于两个五样本提示的前端模型（摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: Mobile AI Factory是一个智能体系统，能够自动为目标任务和目标手机构建经过微调与量化的专用小型语言模型，通过编排器LLM自主决策超参数调优、真实数据挖掘或合成数据生成，并借助目标手机的真实测量数据实现高性能端侧部署。
en_tdlr: Mobile AI Factory is an agentic system that automatically builds fine-tuned, quantized small language models tailored to a given task and phone, using an orchestrator LLM to decide among hyperparameter tuning, real data mining, or synthetic data generation, while leveraging real on-device measurements for high-performance deployment.
